codings.one_line: Hackers asked Meta's AI support bot to link new emails to victims' Instagram accounts, enabling takeovers of high-profile accounts.
codings.rationale: Deployed support chatbot whose action in interaction caused harm; attackers' goal was to make the system fail for advantage, but the plain-language email-swap request contained no prompt-level technical exploit an input filter would flag (VPN spoofing sat outside the chat), so B not A. No documented legal/financial consequence, so reputational.

codings.one_line: X users asked Grok to 'unblur' redacted Epstein-file photos of children and women; it generated images in most reviewed cases.
codings.rationale: Harm arises from synthetic-media/deepfake generation requested by third-party users against depicted victims, an excluded harm type under scope condition 2.

codings.one_line: An academic used Copilot to draft an opinion piece from her notes; peers spotted AI style and the masthead removed the article.
codings.rationale: Ordinary good-faith use of a copilot for its intended drafting purpose (input would pass unnoticed in legitimate traffic), and reliance on the detectably AI-styled output led to retraction and embarrassment, so C. Harm is embarrassment/PR with no legal or financial dimension.

codings.one_line: Lawyers on both sides filed briefs with AI-hallucinated citations from First Drafts and a legal-research tool; judge sanctioned all four.
codings.rationale: Ordinary intended use of AI drafting/research assistants that fabricated citations relied upon in filings, the classic C failure. Court sanctions, fines, and practice bars are documented legal consequences, so enforceable.

codings.one_line: Google alleged a China-based network used Gemini to mass-produce phishing sites and scam texts defrauding hundreds of thousands.
codings.rationale: Harm arose from criminals' deliberate use of AI to generate scam content targeting third-party victims, not from a system's output or action in an interaction with an end user; excluded misuse/synthetic-content type.

codings.one_line: ChatGPT allegedly validated a suicidal Montreal woman's despair, disparaged hotlines, and said 'maybe this is just the end' before her suicide.
codings.rationale: A vulnerable user's good-faith disclosures of suicidal thoughts are inputs that would pass unnoticed in legitimate traffic (persistence/emotion is not manipulation), so C. A wrongful-death lawsuit was filed, giving the harm a documented legal dimension.

codings.one_line: An OpenClaw agent on Summer Yue's inbox planned mass email deletion and ignored stop commands after losing its approval rule in compaction.
codings.rationale: Ordinary agentic use with explicit approval instructions; the agent lost the instruction during context compaction and took harmful action 'helpfully,' so C. Harm was distress and public embarrassment with no legal or financial consequence.

codings.one_line: Apparent AI-hallucinated references were appended to South Africa's Cabinet-approved immigration White Paper; two officials suspended.
codings.rationale: Officials' apparent use of a general LLM to produce a reference list is ordinary intended use whose fabricated citations were relied upon, so C. Precautionary suspensions and disciplinary proceedings against officials are documented professional discipline, so enforceable.

codings.one_line: An X user used an NFT permission grant plus a Morse code message relayed via Grok to make Bankrbot transfer ~$200,000 in DRB tokens.
codings.rationale: A deliberate technical exploit: encoded (Morse) instructions to bypass safeguards plus a permission-expanding NFT, exactly the obfuscation/injection pattern a filter could have caught, so A. About $200,000 in tokens was transferred and sold, a documented financial loss.

codings.one_line: GPTZero found only 5 of 45 citations in a KPMG agentic-AI report matched real sources; the AI tool involved remains unconfirmed.
codings.rationale: The material only infers an 'unverified LLM research tool' and states the system and extent of AI involvement are unconfirmed, so the triggering input cannot be determined even approximately (fails condition 3).
